race.comment: EXCEED PERFECTION (1) did a good job first-up over 1300m at the Sunshine Coast then disappointed in a Class 1 there last start after being in contention on straightening. Best form measures up strongly so in a race of questionable quality he can return to form. INVISIBLE TARGET (7) raced a bit closer to the speed last time out and held on well to be beaten under a length over this distance at Dalby. Has been in work for a while but is holding his form well. Right in the mix again. ESCAPE BEACH (4) surrendered an early lead then came again to be beaten just a long neck over today's journey at Casino recently. The gate is a concern but with any luck she should play a role in the outcome. KOOL BRUCE (8) was plain at Inverell last start but is worth another chance following a five-week let-up. MYSTICAL GEM (5) might be the big improver with visors going back on.
